Chi siamo

We're one of Italy's leading independent immigration consultancies, helping corporate multinationals, businesses and individuals navigate the complexities of moving to Italy. Our team of attorneys, relocation experts, real estate agents, tax advisors, and genealogical research specialists provide comprehensive support across all aspects of Italian immigration, relocation, and settlement — anywhere in Italy. From initial consultation to final settlement, we ensure full compliance with Italian laws while delivering proactive, cost-effective solutions tailored to each client's needs. Through our trusted global partners, we serve clients worldwide. Our mission is to make your transition to Italy seamless so you can focus on what matters—your work, your business, and your new life in Italy.

    Moving abroad? Don't leave your AIRE registration to chance. 🌍✈️ Relocating to a new country is an exciting milestone, but among the packing lists and new job contracts, one crucial step often gets overlooked: AIRE registration. If you are an Italian citizen living abroad for more than 12 months, registering with the Anagrafe degli Italiani Residenti all’Estero is not just a formality, it is a strategic move to protect your rights. Why does it matter? 🛂 Consular Services: Renew your passport or ID card at your local consulate without the need to fly back to Italy. 🗳️ Voting Rights: Exercise your right to vote in national elections and referendums via postal ballot. ⚖️ Fiscal Clarity: It is a key factor in defining your tax residency and avoiding potential double taxation issues. 📜 Certificates: Access vital records and official certificates directly from your new home abroad. ⚠️ Important: As of January 1st, 2024, the Italian Budget Law has introduced strict administrative fines for failing to register with AIRE.  Non-compliance can now result in penalties ranging from €200 to €1,000 for each year of non-registration (up to a maximum of 5 years).  Registering now is no longer just a recommendation, it is essential to avoid significant financial penalties. The catch? The bureaucracy can be slow, and the portal isn't always intuitive. At MP Immigration, we specialize in streamlining the AIRE application process. We ensure your documentation is flawless, saving you time and avoiding administrative headaches. 👉 Planning your move? Let us handle the paperwork while you focus on your new adventure. Contact us today for a consultation! #Expats #MovingAbroad #ItalianCitizenship #AIRE #GlobalMobility #Relocation #Immigration
